item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,work\\n\\ndef check(req,pol,expected):\\n r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=work.evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert req==r0 and pol==p0; assert list(got)==['needs_review','changed']\\ncheck({'declared':['b','a','a','ignored','irrelevant'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':{'z':1,'a':2}},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'a':2,'z':1},'hash':'x','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['ignored','b']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})\\ncheck({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','name':'same'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'y','name':'same'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']})\\ncheck({'declared':['m'],'saved':{},'current':{'m':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json')); assert set(schema['required'])=={'needs_review','changed'} and schema['additionalProperties'] is False\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
